blocks.text: Penicillin adopt following way to kill bacteria;

items: Targeting Bacteria: Penicillin target bacteria because animal cells lack the cell walls that are targeted by the drug.
Cell Wall Inhibition: It interrupt the cross-linking of peptidoglycan (murein) chains, stopping new cell wall synthesis of bacteria.
Lysing bacterial Cell: The bacterial cell wall can no longer maintain structural integrity and it may burst (lysis), after the attack of penicillin (kills rather than just inhibits growth).
Resistance Mechanisms: Some bacteria defend themselves by producing specific enzymes like beta-lactamases.
